ss-delta 0.6.1 adds 90 and 120 fps targets, a CAS sharpening filter, and separate sensitivity settings for the two sticks. It also fixes audio when you open Settings during Ad Hoc Play. Android can now share a diagnostic report from setup or from the game.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.6.1-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.6.1-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.6.1-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.6.1-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. On Android, install the APK and open the app. Setup builds the game from your own Soul Sacrifice Delta dump (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30) and PS Vita firmware. On macOS, if Gatekeeper blocks the first launch, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose **Open Anyway**. [Installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md)

## New

* **90 and 120 fps** for high-refresh displays. Change the target while playing in **Settings → Display**. The default is still 60 fps, and 30 fps is available for the Vita's frame rate.
* **CAS sharpening** in **Settings → Display**, contributed by Abdeygodin. CAS is AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening and runs in a single Vulkan pass. [Vita3K #8](https://github.com/vita-recomps/Vita3K/pull/8)
* **Left and right stick sensitivity** in **Settings → Game**. Tune movement and camera response independently while playing. Both settings default to 1.0. [#36](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/36)
* **Android diagnostic reports**, contributed by ELLINDON. Use **View diagnostic report** or **Share diagnostic report** in setup, or **Share diagnostic report** on the game's Debug page. Reports include device details and recent setup and game log lines. [#29](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/29) · [Vita3K #2](https://github.com/vita-recomps/Vita3K/pull/2)

## Fixed

* **Ad Hoc Play audio.** Opening Settings mutes audio while the device keeps draining it and the game stays connected. Offline pause still suspends audio.
* **Live display changes.** Switching back to 30 fps takes effect immediately. Vulkan now responds to live VSync changes.
* **Controls.** Remapped stick clicks and Guide no longer trigger their original actions too. The mouse camera supports mouse buttons as its capture binding. Touch and pen events are ignored during keyboard and mouse binding capture. Enter always confirms in the desktop settings menu.
* **Setup and shutdown.** Dumps with a standalone title folder and a rePatch mod install both. Setup clears stale error messages, retries slow compiler mirrors, and reuses an installed `adb` for `--android` when available. A rare shutdown hang with a full display queue is fixed.
* **Android upgrades with both regions installed.** Setup rebuilds from the installed title whose module dumps are complete, so an EU build can update with the US title installed alongside it.

## Updating

On a PC, unpack 0.6.1 over the existing game folder, replace the files, and start it with `--install` to build again. RecompLauncher does the rebuild after updating. On Android, install the APK over the existing app and let setup rebuild. Your saves and settings are kept. [Updating guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating)

See the [changelog](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list. The downloads include SHA-256 checksum files and GitHub build attestations.
